one_liner: Spott builds AI-native applicant tracking and CRM software for recruiting firms; its reported €18.3 million Series A makes it too late for pre-first-round outreach.

top_signals.signal: Spott reportedly raised €21.5 million: a €3.2 million seed round in March 2025 and an €18.3 million Series A in September 2026.
Y Combinator lists Spott in its 2025–2026 European cohort.

Model score 84.7 of 100 (at the top of the reference cohort). Positive inputs include YC participation, a three-person founding team with a CTO, Bain experience, and flags for selling to businesses, deep tech, a technical founder, and a founder from a top university.

team: Lander Degrève is co-founder and CEO; his record lists Bocconi University, JPMorgan, and Bain & Company. Manu Vanderveeren is co-founder and COO, and Samuel Smeys is co-founder and CTO. The founder records confirm the CTO role but do not confirm the model’s technical-founder or top-university flags.
why_early: Whether either round was priced is unknown. The reported seed and Series A outweigh the “Pre-Crunchbase / Undiscovered” badge for outreach timing.
devils_advocate_risks: Competition in HR software is a stated risk; Spott’s differentiation from other recruiting platforms is unknown.
International expansion may require localized operations and infrastructure that can support more customers.
next_step: HTGF Industrial Tech team: deprioritize for pre-first-round outreach. If contact is made, ask: Was the March 2025 seed round a priced equity round?
